name: jantt-monorepo
description: Jantt - The JSON Gantt chart engine

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/elements/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/vue/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/svelte/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/yjs/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/interop/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/render-canvas/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/cloud-api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/playground/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && node --check cli/bin/jantt.js && node --check packages/mcp/bin/jantt-mcp.js
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');for(const group of ['packages','apps'])for(const pkg of fs.readdirSync(group))for(const out of ['dist','.vite','tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'])fs.rmSync(path.join(group,pkg,out),{recursive:true,force:true})"
